Name: Grow That Giant Crop
Author: MercuryVN
Description:
[b][size=4]Mod detail[/size]
[/b][size=3]The mods that provide propper end-game ways to grow giant crops without relying too much on RNG is not updated yet, so I [s]blatantly cheat it out[/s] made a mod that helps me decorate my farm with giant crops
[/size]
[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=3]Extract and put in the Mods folder
[/size][size=3]
[/size][b][size=4]How to use[/size][/b]
[size=3]Make sure the following requirements are met:[list]
[*]All 9 crop tiles within a 3x3 space are the same crop and can grow into giant crop
[*]All 9 crop tiles are watered
[*]All 9 crop tiles are fully grown (harvestable) 
[/list]Then standing on the top left corner of the 3x3 space you want to grow the giant crop on and press the grow crop button (configurable), the giant crop will magically appear
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=4][b]Config
[/b][/size][size=3]Run the game with this mod at least once to generate config.json file
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]GrowCropButton: button used to [s]cheat out[/s] magically grow a giant crop, default  is the ` button (OemTilde)[/size]
[*][size=3]EnableMod: Turning the mod on or off, default is true (on)[/size]
[/list][size=3]Compatible with [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/size]
[/url][b][size=4]Change log
[/size][/b][size=3]0.1.0: Initial release
0.1.1: Update for me to have more debug logging option
0.2.0: Make the check for giant crop a bit more consistent
0.3.0: Allow to grow giant crops in locations other than the main farm[/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]Only tested on Windows
Have not tested with other more giant crops mods, but should be compatible
Have not tested if there are other mods conflict
Have not tested in multiplayer

[/size][b][size=4]External[/size][/b]
[size=3]Source code: [url=https://github.com/MercuryVN/GrowThatGiantCrop]Github[/url][/size]
